questions.question: In which city were the Beatles formed?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that the Beatles were an English rock band formed in Liverpool in 1960.
Incorrect. The article does not say London was the city where the Beatles were formed.
Incorrect. Hamburg is where the Beatles played clubs and built their reputation, not where they were formed.
Incorrect. Manchester is not mentioned in the article as the formation city of the Beatles.

questions.question: Which of the following was NOT a member of the Beatles?
answer_explanations: Correct. Pete Best was a drummer who was replaced by Ringo Starr; the four members were Lennon, McCartney, Harrison, and Starr.
Incorrect. John Lennon is listed as one of the four band members.
Incorrect. Paul McCartney is listed as one of the four band members.
Incorrect. George Harrison is listed as one of the four band members.

questions.question: In what year did Ringo Starr officially join the Beatles?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Starr officially joined in 1962.
Incorrect. 1960 is the year the band was formed and began playing clubs, not when Starr joined.
Incorrect. 1958 is when Lennon, McCartney, and Harrison had been together since, not when Starr joined.
Incorrect. 1964 is when the Beatles were international stars, not when Starr joined.

questions.question: Who was the Beatles' manager?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article identifies Brian Epstein as the manager who moulded them into a professional act.
Incorrect. George Martin was the producer, not the manager.
Incorrect. Allan Williams was their unofficial manager, not their manager.
Incorrect. Bert Kaempfert was a producer who contracted them, not their manager.

questions.question: Which song was the Beatles' first hit?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states they achieved their first hit, "Love Me Do", in late 1962.
Incorrect. "Please Please Me" was recorded later and predicted to be their first No. 1, but not their first hit.
Incorrect. "My Bonnie" was recorded with Tony Sheridan and reached number 32 on a German chart, not their first hit.
Incorrect. "P.S. I Love You" was recorded in a later session, not identified as their first hit.

questions.question: In what year did the Beatles retire from live performances?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states the Beatles retired from live performances in 1966.
Incorrect. 1964 is when they became international stars, not when they retired from live performances.
Incorrect. 1967 is the release year of Sgt. Pepper's, not the retirement year.
Incorrect. 1970 is the year of the Beatles' break-up, not their retirement from live performances.

questions.question: What is the title of the Beatles' 1964 film debut?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states they made their film debut with A Hard Day's Night (1964).
Incorrect. Help! was released in 1965, after their film debut.
Incorrect. Let It Be is a 1970 documentary film, not their 1964 debut.
Incorrect. Abbey Road is a 1969 album, not a film.

questions.question: What corporation did the Beatles found in 1968?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that in 1968, the Beatles founded Apple Corps.
Incorrect. EMI is the record label they signed with, not a corporation they founded.
Incorrect. Parlophone is EMI's label, not a corporation founded by the Beatles.
Incorrect. Polydor is a record label they recorded for, not a corporation they founded.

questions.question: How many number-one singles do the Beatles have on the Billboard Hot 100?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states they have the most number-one singles on the Billboard Hot 100 (20).
Incorrect. 19 is the number of number-one albums on the Billboard 200, not singles on the Hot 100.
Incorrect. 21.9 million is the record for most singles sold in the UK, not Billboard Hot 100 number-one singles.
Incorrect. 15 is the record for most number-one albums on the UK Albums Chart, not Billboard Hot 100 singles.

questions.question: In what year were the Beatles inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states they were inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in their first year of eligibility, 1988.
Incorrect. 1980 is the year John Lennon was murdered.
Incorrect. 1994 is when individual principal member inductions began, not the band's induction.
Incorrect. 2001 is the year George Harrison died.
